post.title: How would you react to the bride paying for everyone’s bachelorette trip? How should I communicate it?
post.body_preview:
Has anyone been to bachelorette where the bride pays for the full weekend. 

I am in a spot financially where I could treat all my girls to a surprise “I’m paying for it all...
post.top_comment: You could give them each a card to open once they're all there that says something adorable like "Consider this weekend my treat—your only job is to hang out, relax, and maybe let me pretend I’m a princess for tonight...
